_comment: Curated, human-reviewed manifest for scripts/whistlebird_migration.py --dry-run-production-sheet / --apply-production-sheet. Never auto-regenerated from the live Google Sheet. Edit this file directly to correct a date, quantity, or link, then rerun --confirm-reset-whistlebird-test followed by --apply-production-sheet to replay deterministically. See docs/whistlebird-production-sheet-migration-plan.md and whistlebird-findings.md (WB-020 onward) for how each field below was resolved.
